text:
Priya Singh: FYI procurement sent a new ETA update for H200 racks in EU. Looks like a slip that could hit our late-Nov/Dec peak.
Alex Kim: paste the ETAs? need to map to the holiday surge window.
Priya Singh: EU H200 delivery moved 2029-11-15 -> 2029-12-27. NA still 2029-11-20.
Liam O'Connor: that overlaps the worst of holiday traffic. ballpark GPU-hours impact?
Priya Singh: Q4 baseline = 1.2M GPU-hours. Holiday +30% (Nov20






-Jan5) => +360k. EU share ~28% -> ~100k extra during gap.
Jamal Carter: Options sketch: 1) shift some EU load to NA (latency/regulatory tradeoffs), 2) stand up temporary L40S burst pool in EU for stateless/short-context traffic, 3) swap a portion of H200 reservations to H100, 4) tighten model footprints (quantize / smaller variants).
Alex Kim: runtime note: our long-context, retrieval-augmented models rely on H200 memory to hold KV caches for 32k+ contexts. L40S won't fit the biggest configs; H100 can but perf differs.
Priya Singh: simple cost metric (cloud-eq per GPU-hour): H200 $3.20, H100 $2.35, L40S $1.05. Reserved pricing changes but relative units hold. Converting 20% H200->H100 lowers cost but may add latency for long-context queries.
SRE Bot: [deploy-bot] autoscaler policy h200-eu updated: allow fallback to h100-eu (enabled).
Maya Patel: If we fallback to H100 for certain model classes, we need a perf SLO whitelist and customer notification for high-importance tenants.
Priya Singh: Proposed hybrid Q4 plan: (A) keep 70% H200 reservations, (B) convert 20% to H100 (split NA/EU), (C) add 50-node L40S burst pool in EU for short-context/stateless inference, (D) implement routing rules by model class and latency tier.
Liam O'Connor: rough capacity math: 20% H200->H100 conversion nets ~80k GPU-hours for Q4; L40S burst (50 nodes * 24h * 45 days) ~54k if saturated. Combined ~134k buffer vs EU ~100k extra.
Alex Kim: two technical caveats: 1) checkpoint/kernel compatibility across H200/H100 (quantization + kernels), 2) autoscaler warmup for H100 can be longer for large-memory instances so tune prewarm.
Priya Singh: risk call: latency/regression risk for ~<8% of queries (long-context); operational complexity moderate; procurement risk lower for H100 per vendor note.
Maya Patel: comms plan: notify top-10 impacted customers and update status page. CS to prep messaging and SL adjustments if needed.
Jamal Carter: approvals needed: eng-infra + product sign-off for reservation mix change; finance to OK budget shift (estimated +3% cost delta vs planned but avoids potential outage/migration costs).
Priya Singh: decision ask: approve hybrid reservation plan and authorize procurement for H100/EU L40S PO by EOD tomorrow to hit before Nov surge.
Alex Kim: +1 from infra; we'll implement routing, perf whitelist, and a canary in staging.
Maya Patel: +1 from product. I'll draft customer comms and get CS aligned; send me the customer list.
Priya Singh: action items: Priya - submit revised PO for H100/EU L40S (confirm ETAs) due 2029-07-22 12:00 UTC; Alex - implement routing + perf whitelist + canary tests (staging) due 2029-07-24; Jamal - update cost model and sign budget shift due 2029-07-23; Maya - draft comms for top 10 customers due 2029-07-22.
SRE Bot: [incident-bot] scheduled config rollout for routing rules 2029-07-24T02:00Z.
Priya Singh: if any alternative (swap with partner inventory or spot lease) surface it here fast. otherwise proceeding with PO tomorrow.
Alex Kim: add console metric: H200 vs H100 token-level cost & latency so product/CS can monitor regression in real time.
Maya Patel: added to rollout checklist.
Priya Singh: closing loop moving forward on hybrid plan unless objections by EOD.
